abstract: The number of people traveling without a tour guide has increased, and Seoul, South Korea is one of the popular destinations that people often visit. So, we decided to create this project, which is a Seoul travel guide, a web application for providing travel information about Seoul, and the provided information of the places, come from our experience, so we would say that some of the places are the local place which popular in those specific area, and might not be in any of others travel guide. We designed our website base on separating the users into two types, the group of people who have gone and never have gone to Seoul. We provided both of the user types with our three main features, browsing which allow the user to search by category, searching, which allow user to type in the specific keyword that they want to look for, and exploring, which allow both group of users to explore Seoul by our provided functions. We also evaluated our system by asking a sample group of people about the feedback after experience our website.

abstract: This project presents a Body Weight Balancing system to be used in predicting the number of days needed for a person to get to a normal weight state based on his or her Body Mass Index (BMI), Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR), and Daily Food Intake Calorie (DIFC). By using BMI value, the system estimates the weight value of a person, where the individual with a normal BMI has a weight value of zero. Based on BMR, the Daily Needed Calorie (DNC) of a person is calculated, and from the DNC, the weight value and the DIFC, the number of days needed for a person to get a normal BMI state could be predicted. And also the presented system would recommend needed food items for a person based on his/her weight value.
